manifest.name: Zotero MetaFlow
manifest.description: Validate, organize and enrich reference metadata in Zotero.
manifest.author: groele

nativeFinal.scope: Targeted core-workflow, cache-feedback and production XPI installation regression. Includes no inline bar during execution, native cancellation, five-second completion, click-only reports and closing before initialization finishes.

crossPlatformCandidate.failure: Linux native-window alignment settled after the initial animation-frame positioning. Added bounded retiling and main-window resize tracking; final CI must recheck.

limits: Previous full-suite evidence belongs to 11.2.0. This patch uses targeted native regressions.
The final 11.2.1 XPI was not rerun on Zotero 11.
No full third-party co-install matrix or long-duration large-library validation.
Commercial redistribution conditions for reference datasets remain documented in the audit ledger.
